name: Dog-Faced Kobold (Kobold Variant)
body:
This variety of kobolds has scaly hides that usually range from black to brown to rust red, but can also come in bright colors like standard kobolds. Most notably, their faces end in short, dog-like muzzles filled with sharp teeth, making them look more canine than draconic. It also makes their speech sound muddled, and it doesn’t help that they fill it with yips and growling noises. In addition to their pronounced muzzles, they also have abnormally large eyes and ears.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Wis, –2 Int, –4 Str. This trait alters ability scores.
Dog-Face You have heightened senses, giving you a +2 species bonus to Perception checks. In addition, you gain a bite attack; this is a natural attack that deals 1d3 damage. This trait replaces crafty.
Alternate Species Trait

Dragonblood For the purposes of effects targeting creatures by type (such as a ranger’s favored enemy and bane weapons), as well as access to feats, magic items, and so on, you are treated both as a humanoid (with the reptilian subtype) and as a dragon. This trait alters your type.
